lines.text: Cartier once made Snow White charms.
Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs premiered in Los Angeles in 1937.
lines.say: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs premiered in Los Angeles in nineteen thirty seven.

lines.text: The premiere was held at the Carthay Circle Theatre.
Cartier made a gold and enamel charm bracelet for the film.
Eight charms showed Snow White and each of the seven dwarfs.
The charms are 14 karat gold and enamel, signed Cartier.
lines.say: The charms are fourteen karat gold and enamel, signed Cartier.

lines.text: Lillian Disney wore a Snow White charm bracelet to the premiere.
Walt had his own gold and enamel piece, a Dopey money clip.
Shirley Temple handed Walt a full size Oscar and seven miniatures.
Lillian's bracelet is kept in the Walt Disney Family Museum.

post.caption: Cartier once made Snow White charms. Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs premiered at the Carthay Circle Theatre in Los Angeles in 1937. Cartier made a gold and enamel charm bracelet for the film, with eight charms showing Snow White and each dwarf. The charms are 14 karat gold, signed Cartier. Lillian Disney wore a Snow White charm bracelet to the premiere, and Walt had a gold and enamel Dopey money clip. Shirley Temple handed Walt a full size Oscar and seven miniatures. Lillian's bracelet is kept in the Walt Disney Family Museum in San Francisco.
